medium.observation: Per-question diagnosis and targeted remediation are complete, but all of them live inside the closed-by-default detailed-results disclosure while the visible primary action immediately continues to the next Subject B activity.
medium.learner_risk: A learner who misses questions can follow the dominant action without seeing the available reason classification, explanation-driven recovery step, or targeted practice button, adding avoidable friction to the wrong-answer -> understanding -> retry loop.
medium.recommended_repair: Keep the existing next-Subject-B primary hierarchy for strong attempts, but when wrong or blank answers exist surface one concise wrong-answer review/recovery entry point before continuation (or auto-open a compact remediation summary) without expanding all 20 reviews by default.
